root_cause: Measurement and voice calibration shared source retirement: when tones expired, exhausted samples or were canceled, live microphone audio became the TX input while the radio could still be keyed.
The packet send path had no final measurement-expiry check, allowing already-generated nonzero payload after expiry.
fix: Latch measurement ownership from PTT/key admission through a complete READY report, including across incomplete status.
Measurement never blends to microphone; completed/canceled/expired source holds zero output, including correction residuals.
Recheck measurement wall-clock expiry immediately before each TX datagram; replace retired payload with zeros.
Voice calibration keeps its intended microphone handoff; a later fresh key after complete READY can carry normal voice.
evidence_scope: New nonzero-microphone regression failed before fix at output_peak==0.
Separate prepared-packet dispatch regression failed before final send guard.
3 native ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer tests passed; initial sandbox LeakSanitizer permission failure preserved.
ARMv7 Cortex-A8 and ARM64 static DSP builds passed.
User documentation build and diff whitespace check passed.
limitations: Not installed: current radio remains unreachable after prior reboot.
Zero waveform payload is not proof of physical RF zero or confirmed PTT release on actual firmware.
No new continuous-duration, final-process crash/RF, corrected-spectrum or actual6300 hardware claim.
The14second operation budget versus analyzer10second transmit/release contract remains unresolved; this fix does not close it.
